storage: Close must not rewrite the snapshot when the session wrote nothing. Surfaced by v1.1-coi-screen-real-corpus (#594): a read-only consumer rewrites the 1.1 GB snapshot.mmap on every exit (8.3 s / 7.9 GB; JSON 25 s / 17.5 GB). Acceptance: mtime and bytes unchanged after a read-only open/close, changed after one write, both seen red first; WAL truncate stays tied to a snapshot that happened.
